title: S09T06 - Make the evidence-based go, iterate, narrow, or stop decision
description: Review release gates, benchmarks, beta behavior, operational burden, and differentiation; publish only when thresholds pass and otherwise create a smaller evidence-backed follow-up backlog.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision records which quantitative and qualitative gates passed, failed, or were forced and links the underlying evidence.
A go decision publishes and tags the public beta with a post-launch support plan; any other decision narrows or stops scope without presenting partial validation as success.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
